low_quality.title: Nice truck for sale runs good
low_quality.description: Good truck, runs and drives. Has some miles on it but still good. Call me for more info.

issues_found: No interior photos showing dashboard or seats
Some photos appear dark or poorly lit
photos.why_it_matters: Buyers rely on photos to assess vehicle condition before contacting you. Listings with 10+ quality photos receive 2.5x more inquiries. Interior photos are the second most viewed images after the main exterior shot.
recommended_actions: Add clear photos of the dashboard and gauge cluster
Include front and rear seat photos
Take an odometer reading photo for mileage verification
Photograph all four tires to show tread condition
Retake exterior photos in natural daylight

issues_found: Missing year, make, and model information
No key features mentioned (4x4, Crew Cab)
title.why_it_matters: Buyers search for specific vehicles using filters. Titles without year/make/model/trim won't appear in filtered searches, reducing visibility by up to 60%. Clear titles get 40% more clicks.
recommended_actions: Start with: 2019 Ford F-150 XLT
Add body style: Crew Cab or SuperCrew
Include drivetrain: 4x4 or 4WD
Remove subjective words like 'nice' or 'good'

description.why_it_matters: Detailed descriptions build buyer confidence and trust. Listings that mention service history see 35% higher contact rates. Vague descriptions make buyers suspicious about hidden issues.
recommended_actions: Describe interior and exterior condition honestly
List recent maintenance (oil changes, tire rotations, brake service)
Highlight key features (SYNC 3, leather seats, tow package)
Add financing options and trade-in availability
Include a clear call-to-action to schedule a test drive

issues_found: Higher than 85% of similar listings in your area
No price justification in listing (premium features, low miles)
price.why_it_matters: Competitively priced listings sell 2x faster. Buyers compare 8+ listings before contacting a dealer. Overpriced listings often sit for weeks, leading to eventual price drops anyway.
recommended_actions: Consider adjusting to $26,500-$27,500 range
Or highlight premium features that justify higher price
Add 'Price Reduced' tag if lowering
Offer incentives like free delivery or warranty

medium_quality.title: 2020 Toyota Tacoma TRD Sport - Low Miles
medium_quality.description: 2020 Toyota Tacoma TRD Sport with only 72,000 km. 3.5L V6 engine, automatic transmission. Clean title, no accidents. Well maintained. Comes with tonneau cover. Contact us for more information or to schedule a viewing.

issues_found: Engine bay photo would add transparency
photos.why_it_matters: You're close to optimal photo count. Adding verification photos (odometer, tires) builds trust and answers common buyer questions before they ask, reducing back-and-forth and speeding up sales.
recommended_actions: Add an odometer photo showing current mileage
Photograph tire tread depth
Include a clean engine bay photo
Consider adding a cargo bed photo with tonneau open

issues_found: 'Low Miles' is subjective - actual km would be clearer
title.why_it_matters: Your title is good but could be more specific. Buyers filter by 4x4/4WD, so including this increases search visibility. Specific mileage in title can attract serious buyers faster.
recommended_actions: Add '4x4' or '4WD' to the title
Consider: '2020 Toyota Tacoma TRD Sport 4x4 - 72K km'
Keep total length under 70 characters

issues_found: Good basics but lacks specific condition details
description.why_it_matters: You have a solid foundation. Adding service records and specific feature callouts (like TRD-tuned suspension, crawl control) differentiates your listing from competitors with similar vehicles.
recommended_actions: Add recent service details (timing, dealer records)
Highlight TRD Sport specific features
Describe interior condition (leather, cloth, wear)
Mention warranty status if applicable
Add financing availability and trade-in welcome

issues_found: Competitive but could attract more views if adjusted
price.why_it_matters: Your pricing is reasonable. A small adjustment of $500-$1,000 could move you from 'competitive' to 'attractive' and significantly increase inquiry rates without major profit impact.
recommended_actions: Consider $34,400 to hit a psychological price point
Or add value (warranty, accessories) at current price
Highlight the tonneau cover value in description

high_quality.title: 2021 RAM 1500 Laramie Crew Cab 4x4 - One Owner, Dealer Serviced
high_quality.description:
Stunning 2021 RAM 1500 Laramie Crew Cab 4x4 with only 48,500 km. One owner, always dealer serviced.

**Key Features:**
• 5.7L HEMI V8 with eTorque mild hybrid
• 12-inch Uconnect 5 touchscreen
• Leather heated/ventilated front seats
• Heated steering wheel
• Panoramic sunroof
• Spray-in bedliner
• Trailer tow package with brake controller

**Condition:**
Exterior: Excellent - minor stone chips on hood (normal wear)
Interior: Like new - non-smoker, no pets
Mechanical: Perfect - all scheduled maintenance completed at RAM dealer

**Recent Service (at 45,000 km):**
• Full synthetic oil change
• Tire rotation and balance
• Brake inspection - 70% pad life remaining
• Multi-point inspection passed

**Included:**
• 2 key fobs with remote start
• All original manuals and window sticker
• Complete service records
• Clean Carfax - no accidents, no damage

**Warranty:**
• Powertrain warranty valid until 100,000 km
• Extended warranty available for purchase

Financing available with rates from 4.99%. Trade-ins welcome - we'll beat any reasonable offer!

Contact us today to schedule your test drive. This truck won't last long!

photos.why_it_matters: Your photo gallery is outstanding! This level of visual documentation builds immediate trust and lets buyers feel confident before they even contact you.
recommended_actions: Consider adding a walk-around video for extra engagement
Update photos if any new accessories are added
Keep this standard for future listings

issues_found: Excellent structure with all key information
Good use of trust signals (One Owner, Dealer Serviced)
title.why_it_matters: Your title is nearly perfect. It includes all searchable terms and adds trust-building language that differentiates you from generic listings.
recommended_actions: No changes needed
This is a template worth reusing for other listings

issues_found: Clear formatting with bullet points and sections
description.why_it_matters: This description answers virtually every question a buyer might have. The transparency about minor wear actually builds trust - it shows you're honest.
recommended_actions: No major changes needed
Consider adding a specific appointment booking link if available
Update service records if any new maintenance is performed

issues_found: Well-justified by condition and service history
price.why_it_matters: Your price is well-positioned. The combination of condition, documentation, and remaining warranty justifies asking near the top of the market range.
recommended_actions: Price is appropriate - no changes recommended
If no inquiries after 14 days, consider a small adjustment
Highlight the warranty value in buyer conversations
